sources.title: inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Overview Ling-3.0-flash-VL inherits the language, reasoning, and long-context capabilities of Ling-3.0-flash, while extending them with native image and video understanding. The model has 124B total parameters, with only 5.5B parameters activated per token, and supports a context window of up to 1M tokens.
